counting_theorem.Q_definition: Q(R)=# ordered pairs m,n>=1 with m^2+n^2<=R^2; axes excluded
counting_theorem.heat_asymptotic: H_prim(t)=3/(8*pi*t)+O(t^(-1/2)*log(1/t)) as t decreases to zero

heat_transform_theorem.absolute_convergence: for every t>0, dominated by the full positive Gaussian lattice sum
heat_transform_theorem.absolute_interchange_bound: theta_+(4*t*d^2)<=sqrt(pi)/(4*d*sqrt(t)), so the absolute d-sum is bounded by pi/(16*t)*sum d^(-2)
heat_transform_theorem.collision_convention: each ordered positive primitive direction contributes once; coincident lengths add their multiplicities

natural_quantization_boundary.operator: positive Dirichlet half-wave sqrt(-Delta_D) on the unit square

source_lock.clock: squared geometric length in a positive heat transform
source_lock.direction_convention: m,n>=1 ordered; coordinate swap retained; axes excluded; equal lengths retain multiplicity
source_lock.forbidden_data: target tables, prime tables, arithmetic local factors, Euler factors, root numbers, automorphy, Hilbert--Polya, Route B
source_lock.normalization: unit side and unit speed; no fitted parameter
source_lock.object: ordered positive coprime directions of the unit square billiard
source_lock.precision: exact integer coefficients and counts; analytic asymptotic proved separately
